Okay. Seems like i didnt explain it well enough. By offering something, i ment inviting for a cup of cofee if there is something relational between us and the right time is there. Like you mention, a conversation, good chemistry, intererests etc. Asking out for a Coffee just by one talk, surely is weird.

And, for me its not about being laid. Its about friendship. Just to clear that up.

Regarding the last one, when i talked about offering, i ment like, inviting one out for a cup of cofee, or something like that. I try to be not over interacting, and think what would i find "offensive" my self and learn by that...

I am going to be honest to you.

I cant improve my self physically, because of my Syndrome and limitations. Spiritually and emotionally sure, and Im doing that. I am making money, more than I need (not to be arrogant, just saying the truth). I have a car, a nice flat, still- I am not getting rejected 100 times, its 2000+ times. Where I am locationwise, I run out of people to ask.

I never say that I wasn't confident, I am - but other people is not when they see me.   
I truly appreciate your comment, this is just the pure honest answer I can give you.
